## The Staffing Agency Challenge

Your clients expect immediate candidate flow, but your internal recruiters are already at capacity. Turning down business means losing clients to competitors.

Hiring more internal recruiters is expensive and risky—what happens when volume dips? You're stuck with fixed overhead during slow periods.

Niche roles outside your specialization are difficult to fill. You want to say yes to clients, but you lack the sourcing networks for specialized talent.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- White-label recruiting that's invisible to your clients—you own the relationship
- Overflow support during high-volume periods without permanent headcount
- Niche role filling: access our networks for roles outside your core specialization
- Consistent candidate flow: we deliver qualified candidates, you do final selection
- Flexible capacity: scale partnership up or down based on your pipeline
